result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides requested transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, preserves the 30-day machine-readable data-return obligation, and requires secure deletion followed by written officer certification. The revision appropriately resolves the contradiction in Section 11.1 without unnecessarily altering Sections 11.2 or 11.3, preserves the existing fee-dispute, metadata, backup, and legal-retention protections, and is professionally drafted.
